summary: Count to 20 and count 10 things, see 5 at a glance, read numbers, add and take away, use first to fifth.
Use position words, name shapes in any turn, describe them, and build or split shapes to make new ones.
Compare and order by size, sort by two features, graph groups, use measuring tools, and continue patterns.
Use counting and math thinking to solve everyday problems, like how many more plates are needed.
